articles.title: LLM Evals Are Based on Vibes — I Built the Missing Layer That Decides What Ships
articles.content: Most LLM evaluation systems rely on vague scoring and human judgment disguised as metrics. I built a lightweight evaluation layer in pure Python that turns LLM outputs into reproducible decisions by separating attribution, specificity, and relevance—so hallucinations are caught before they reach production. The post LLM Evals Are Based on Vibes — I Built the Missing Layer That Decides What Ships appeared first on Towards Data Science.
